architecture_purpose: Procure a contract-first ontology and methodology for decomposing everyday work into governed tasks, workflows, policies, artifacts, and verification steps.

relationships: Policy governs Agent, Workflow, and Task
formal_ontology.contract_rule: All planning and execution must map context to Task, Workflow, Capability, Tool, Goal, Policy, and Artifact before action.
formal_ontology.truth_boundary: Generated architecture language is an internal artifact, not source truth or approval authority.

methodology.execution_rule: Every step must produce internal evidence before downstream use.
methodology.verification_rule: Contract validation, freshness review, quality review, compliance review, and operator gates control promotion.
methodology.reflection_rule: Reflection creates internal update records only; behavior-changing changes require approval.

interface_layer.implementation_boundary: May describe APIs, dashboards, and chat surfaces; may not expose a public service.

orchestration_layer.implementation_boundary: May route internal phase records; may not run unsupervised external workflows.

agent_runtime_layer.implementation_boundary: May define container/serverless contracts; may not launch infrastructure.

knowledge_layer.implementation_boundary: May define vector, graph, and ontology stores; may not ingest private data without approval.

tool_integration_layer.implementation_boundary: May define connector contracts; live write connectors remain disabled.

governance_layer.implementation_boundary: Must enforce policy, audit logs, metrics, approvals, freshness review, and incident response.

agent_procurement.agent_action_boundary: All agents are internal planning, review, routing, and artifact-generation roles until separately authorized.
